stories: Anna's case: Anna was representing a major government contractor whose firm won a competition in partnership with ABC Corp. After winning, ABC felt entitled to payment regardless of work performed, leading to vituperative emails and fragmented relationships. When the client demanded project changes threatening profit margins, Anna needed to cut ABC's pay from 9 people equivalent to 5.5 to 3. Anna prepared by listing all negative accusations ABC could make, role-played with partner Mark, and at the meeting preemptively labeled ABC's fears. By acknowledging ABC's situation and asking open-ended questions, she learned ABC believed Anna's firm was highly profitable. When she explained the client's demands had turned profits into losses, ABC agreed to deeper cuts. This negotiation resulted in $1 million profit for Anna's company.
